capabilities: restore alt+up and alt+down keyboard navigation
restore alt+shift+up and alt+shift+down keyboard navigation
extras: README covers only manual installation; no description of what the shortcuts actually do.
motivation: The README says the plugin restores default macOS keyboard navigation in Obsidian, implying the author missed the system-standard behavior.
problem: On macOS, Obsidian does not honor the default alt+arrow and alt+shift+arrow text-navigation shortcuts users expect system-wide.
summary: Keyboard navigation plugin that restores macOS-style alt+up/down and alt+shift+up/down cursor movement in Obsidian.
